description: Read one job’s application-stage screening: the ACTIVE screening link (course, attempt ceiling, current published version) and every proposal on the job, newest first, with its derived enrollment status (OPEN | IN_PROGRESS | SUBMITTED), whose move it is (WORKER | EMPLOYER | NONE), the effective course version the applicant is enrolled on and whether it is the link’s current one, plus bindingGaps (proposals with no enrollment — backfill with opentrain_lms_screening_assign) and staleVersionCount (enrollments on an older course version, so scores are not directly comparable). Each enrolled proposal carries enrollmentKey = proposal:<jobOfferId>, accepted as the assignmentId of opentrain_lms_review_assignment / grade / release-result / decide. Bounded by limit (default and max 500) with hasMore. Requires lms:read.
name: opentrain_lms_screening_status
